name: Lalamusa

queries.query: Lalamusa Pakistan official cadastral map land records GIS parcel map Punjab
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Punjab Land Records Authority (PLRA), its official PULSE public GIS viewer, the PLRA GIS ArcGIS REST directory, and an official Lalamusa land-use map. The PULSE public viewer exposed Gujrat/Kharian/Mauza hierarchy data and Lalamusa-area mauza extents, but parcel geometry access was not anonymously qualified.

queries.query: لالہ موسیٰ اراضی ریکارڈ نقشہ کیڈسٹرل پنجاب سرکاری
queries.result: اردو میں تلاش سے پنجاب لینڈ ریکارڈز اتھارٹی، آن لائن فرد، اور سرکاری زمین ریکارڈ خدمات سامنے آئیں۔ براہ راست پارسل جیومیٹری یا محفوظ شناختی فیلڈ والا عوامی جواب نہیں ملا؛ PULSE کا عوامی نقشہ hierarchy/mauza فہرست تک محدود رہا۔

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Punjab Land Records Authority / Government of Punjab is the evidenced provincial land-record custodian. The PULSE public GIS viewer exposes Gujrat district, Kharian tehsil and Lala Musa-named mauza records; the PMU-LG&CD Lalamusa map is a municipal land-use/planning map, not a parcel registry.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: The official PULSE public viewer returned first-party administrative/mauza records for Kharian, Gujrat, including Lala Musa-named mauzas and bounding extents. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide parcel coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A current first-party public land-information viewer and PLRA service identity were directly evidenced; no login or unsafe record fields were used.

schemaAndCrs.responseType: JSON administrative/mauza records; parcel feature response not obtained
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Mauza extents are returned as comma-separated WGS84-looking longitude,latitude bounds; parcel CRS was not established
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: mauza objectid was observed in hierarchy responses but is not a parcel identity
schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The public viewer HTML/configuration was retrieved. Anonymous GETs to /Admins/filterDistricts/4, /Admins/filterTehsils/33 and /Admins/filterMauzas/110 returned hierarchy JSON. The d2d parcel endpoint /api/LandHierarchy/GetDivisionsList returned HTTP 401, and no parcel ID-plus-geometry response was retained. The page-referenced gismaps.pulse.gop.pk ArcGIS host did not resolve; the PLRA ArcGIS directory host listed no PULSE_LMKR services.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not executed against a qualified parcel layer. The point is inside returned mauza extents for Dhama, Kaira and Mundeer, but that is not a parcel hit.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab PLRA/PULSE public land-information viewer and Gujrat/Kharian mauza hierarchy.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Administrative and mauza extent discovery only; no parcel geometry or citywide parcel completeness.
